Radial tires track the pulling vehicle well, so there is better sway control on curves. Radial tires run cooler because their steel mesh dissipates heat, which reduces the chance of a blowout and adds to the life of the tire. Radial tires are made by overlapping polyester cords at a 90-degree angle to the center line of the tire, then strengthened with steel mesh belts.
